messages.subject: Ledger plan written (11 tasks); advisory reflect FAIL, 7 blocking
messages.body: Plan written and staged at .dev/tasks/to-do/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181649/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181649.md: 11 tasks in 4 phases, each with checkable acceptance criteria. It covers the review_ledger.py kernel with tests, the sc-review-ledger skill, the full-copy /sc:spec-panel-ledger command with no Unattended section plus its drift test, make sync-dev, the S1 brief templates and INSTALL.md (Task 11); spec-panel.md stays unchanged and the gate passed. The advisory reflect check (Tier 2 with adversarial merge, report .dev/brainstorms/346-ledger/workflow-report/nested/reflect-1/REPORT.md, status partial because 3 citations were dropped) rates the plan FAIL with 7 blocking findings, so it should be regenerated before /sc:implement, and three need your decision: the verbatim S1 review briefs forbid the ledger's own writes and the scripted spec revert (M-F21); spec-panel.md:220 carries a src/superclaude/examples path that the copy and no-path rules cannot both satisfy, so you must pick a template (M-F1); and tests/recommend/test_routing_refresh.py pins the command set and breaks when a command is added (M-F3). The other blocking findings are the severity scan reading tracked files only, Task 2 needing Task 3's verify, the review-1 PASS sweep skip, and the missing 5-minute heartbeat condition; progress.md does not exist because /sc:implement creates it, the SPEC's section 5 experiment steps are out of scope, and the run also wrote the reflect memory file docs/memory/reflect/deviation-patterns-bs346-ledger.md (untracked, not staged).

messages.subject: Question
messages.body: Measurement-copy ruling premise is off by 2 lines. Current src/superclaude/commands/spec-panel.md minus its '## Unattended mode' section is 474 lines (sha256 9cdcd39e2f7c), not the 472-line Arm B file (c8d80346a96c, exp346-p1-logs/.../phase2/S1/inputs/tool-text/spec-panel-post427-95f2c6e4.md). diff shows exactly 2 extra lines in master: line 23, the second Usage line '/sc:spec-panel ... [--target-release <release>] [--output <file>] [--unattended] [--report-dir <dir>] [--improve]', and line 37, 'When --target-release <release> is passed (in any run), that value is used as the target release and the question above is not asked.' Reflect finding C-004 already tells me to drop line 23 (it advertises --unattended). RECOMMENDED (A): drop BOTH lines 23 and 37 too, so the variant base is byte-identical to the 472-line Arm B file and the repo copy really is the measurement copy (line 37 only explains --target-release, which line 23 was the only place to advertise). (B): drop only line 23 (C-004), keep line 37; the variant then differs from the Arm B base by that one line, and INSTALL.md records it. Which?
